screening.method: Known publisher shortlist; canonical tracked skill paths; explicit open license; frontmatter and import-size checks; unique names and normalized bodies; near-duplicate review; static instruction/resource pattern review. No upstream scripts executed. Not a complete security audit or runtime certification.
exclusions: Proprietary, absent, conflicting or unclassified license
Mirrored paths, exact duplicate names/bodies, tests and internal workflows
Direct instruction flags unresolved during screening
Shortened installer URLs in RDS DB2 resources
Copied Key Vault TypeScript examples with unresolved client definitions
New Azure Cosmos Python alias already represented in original catalog
reviewNotes: PostHog similarities retain distinct framework-specific reference files, SDKs and setup; not duplicate packages.
Security examples of hostile prompts/exfiltration are labeled examples for detection, not installation instructions.
Download snippets in supporting references are not executed by Add. Tool/account setup remains explicit.
Publisher for wshobson/agents is Seth Hobson, as credited by its MIT license.
Original 100 entries are preserved exactly in their individual bundles.
